card.name: Small words before percent thresholds
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "in", "by" or "with" right before a percentage or amount cutoff such as "in 5%", "in greater than 2%" or "by approximately 40%". Usually after "occurring", "reported" or "reduced" in adverse reaction text.

modes.label: Incidence phrases
modes.description: The word "in" after "occurring" or "reported", ahead of a percent of patients.

modes.label: Size of change
modes.description: "by" or "with" ahead of an approximate amount or percent change.

card.writes: It promotes comparison signs such as >, <, >= and <=, preparing the model to write a threshold.
card.plain: It fires on the little word before a percentage cutoff, like "occurring in" before "more than 5% of patients".
